batting.name: MEK Hussey
batting.dismissal: c Y Gnaneswara Rao b RA Jadeja

batting.name: SK Raina
batting.dismissal: c RP Singh b S Sreesanth

batting.name: S Badrinath
batting.dismissal: c RP Singh b BJ Hodge

batting.name: MS Dhoni
batting.dismissal: c PA Patel b RA Jadeja

batting.name: PA Patel
batting.dismissal: c JA Morkel b R Ashwin

batting.name: RA Jadeja
batting.dismissal: c SK Raina b DE Bollinger

balls.text: full toss fired in, he goes half-heartedly at it, and gets it high in the air but it falls safely in front of long off
gets the length very full, Albie cannot get underneeath it as he targets deep midwicket, slogs it along the ground to that man in the end
walks down the track looking for another swing over square leg, but takes it on the pads as he misses
angles in the full ball from over the wicket and hits him on the pads as he misses the flick, not given, hit on the back pad, could have gone down leg
slogs the yorker away towards midwicket for a single
Saha has played a little gem here, set himself up for the short ball, it arrived, and he pulled it off the front foot miles over deep midwicket
slap! Albie reaches out for a low full toss and sends it racing past extra cover, long off runs across and gets there in time to prevent the boundary
wants to swing a very full ball from outside off stump but is hit on the pads, outside the line though
gets outside the line of a short of a length ball, and swings it on a knee over the man at short fine leg
cracked off the front foot, but this time extra cover stops it with a dive
full toss outside off and he gets the boundary, throws his bat at it, and gets it through extra cover, even the dive on the boundary doesnt help
smashed off the front foot, hangs in the air for some tie before going on the bounce to sweeper cover

the slow bouncer banged in, gets up so slowly that batsman takes a step towards it, then decides to wait, then decides to have a go, but it has still not arrived, and when it passes him it is given a wide, cruel game, yes
furious yorker from RP, angled in from wide of the crease, he somehow jams it away on the leg side as he manages to get feet out of the way
squeezes the full delivery in front of point, that looks headed to the boundary before sweeper cover gets in the way with a big dive
good delivery, yorker that he jams away to RP;s left and he dives to field
short, wide, Albie reaches out to slap it straight to point, the throw comes in to RP who is some way away from the stumps, Albie is even further, but RP flicks it past the stumps
reaches out to slap a fuller one in the air, but it goes on the bounce to sweeper cover
first ball, he walks across and outside off stump, and swat-flicks the back of a length ball over square leg, some neat work on the boundary saves the four
stabbed away in to the off side towards extra cover, good over from Jadeja
has him awkwardly jabbing at a yorker length ball that is fired in on leg stump
slants the faster one across the left-hander who is expecting it to turn in and is beaten
drags the fuller one down the pads, Albie happily nudges it fine and it runs away to the boundary

Parthiv has taken a catch! he has managed to hold on, Dhoni walks immediately even as Jadeja appeals, it was the flatter and quicker one outside off, did not get up much, he went for cut shot, but edged it in to Parthiv's gloves, and for once, nothing popped out of them
Dhoni is going hard for it now, gets under a full ball and hammers it over the bowler, but long on runs around to cut it off
beats him with a flatter one that turns in sharply from outside off stump, he tries to steer it but missed
Saha in to the act, wicketkeeper from both ends, skips down the track, gets to the pitch, and lofts Murali over the sightscreen
gets the single on the off side this time
smack! Dhoni gets a full delivery, waits for an instant and swings it in to the gap between deep midwicket and long on, came down so hard on the ball
fuller tossed up ball, he comes down the track to ease it down to long off
stretches fully forward to push it towards point for a single

Saha gets away, full toss from Jadeja, he wanted to flick it through midwicket, but gets a leading edge that goes just over extra cover, talk about luck, wretched as well as good, he even picks up a couple of runs
lunges forward to push a fuller one past extra cover
pushes this flat ball in front of extra cover for a single
Hussey is gone, this time he is gone, no more chances, low full toss, he looks to bash it wide of deep midwicket, but can't time it, Gnaneswara  Rao runs across to take the catch
pushed down the ground to long off for a single
Saha bends the knee for the sweep and connects perfectly this time, timed the swipe over deep square leg and all the way over the boundary
this time he flicks hard wide of deep midwicket for a couple
shot! fuller delivery given some air, and he stays beside the line to crack it past a diving extra cover and in to the boundary
this time Hussey tries to do a Saha, sweep that is, he misses as the ball is not full enough and takes it on the body
and again SAha tries to sweep, from outside off stump, and inside edges it to short fine leg
again he abandons the crease, well he has got away with it so far, and drives it to long off
another missed stumping, simple chance, Hussey was miles out of the crease beaten on the wild charge by one that was angled in, but Parthiv could not collect, poor game for the captain so far
fires it in even quicker outside off, SAha who seems to love sweeping, goes down for another sweep, and misses
tries to mow him over midwicket, but mistimes the slog off the inside edge on the leg side
guided past the keeper on the offside for a single
stumping missed fires in the flat and quick ball, angles in past Saha who gives him a blind charge, Parthiv misses the take and SAha lives on
goes for the slog sweep over midwicket, but there is man in the deep and it goes straight to him
goes sweeping again to a flat delivery and again deep square leg is in business
full delivery around off stump, he goes down for the sweep and hits it off the middle of the bat to deep square leg
fuller one but again on leg stump, he gets around it to tuck it to short fine leg
Murali fires it in flat, on the pads, Hussey is prepared with the sweep and forces it backward of square leg
shuffles across the stumps, and tickles it to fine leg
goes for the sweep from outside off stump and gets the single to deep square leg
flighted delivery, turning in and he comes forward to drive in the air to long off
gets it away towards midwicket for a single
fired flat and quick wide down the leg side
can;t get it away, tries to sweep, but misses and takes it on the body
guided off the back foot backward of point
swept away hard to deep square leg
gets it away for a single on the leg side

how is that not out? how on earth? Hussey gets it off the face of the bat as he goes down for the sweep, it loops up in the air for Parthiv to take a simple catch, Rudi shakes his head, Parthiv could have run Hussey out as he was some way outside his crease but he was busy appealing
goes back to tuck it as it turns across sharply and picks up a single on the leg side
guides this one off the front foot backward of point
sharp turn from wide outside off, he is surprised and dabs it back down the track
this time he gets the single, skipping down the track and turning it through midwicket
goes for the reverse sweep this time, gets it off the middle of the bat but right ti short third man
darted in from round the stumps, hits him on the pads as he fails to connect with the flick
turns in from outside off stump, and he takes it on the pads as he misses the waft
hit away to sweeper cover to bring Saha on strike

gone! to one of the catches of the tournament, full delivery from Hodge, again Badri had decided to target the midwicket boundary, but could not time the shot as well as the previous one, long on rushed to his right, even as the ball was dipping on him, he dived to his right and took it inches from the ground, it is RP Singh
this will do, tossed up slowly, Badri waits a while before deciding it has to disappear over deep midwicket, and so it does, he times the big swing perfectly
Badri goes for a pull without control again, this one was short and turning in, and he reached out to pull it ungainly wide of deep midwicket
again he comes down the track, he follow him with a fuller one angled in, and he gets an inside edge through midwicket
low full toss, outside off an cracked off the front foot to sweeper cover
Badri is looking very uncomfortable against the bouncer, surprisingly, goes for the hook to a head high delivery, the top edge falls in the vacant square leg region again
even as this one cuts in from outside off, Badri arches back to adjust and guide it, but straight to backward point
Hussey is struggling, charges down the track, but gets an inside edge to long on

Badri survives, surprise quick bouncer from Vinay, Badri goes for an awkward pull, there was no one at square leg, hodge came running in from midwicket, it was too far from him, maybe a dive would have helped
bowls it on a length close to off stump, he looks to push it on the off side, but almost chops it on to the stumps, bounces high towards the keeper
tossed up full and he drives it with the turn to long on
pushed away in to the off side for a single
gets it to turn in sharply, Badri was on the back foot and hurriedly jab it away to square leg
gets around this fuller one on leg stump, and turned away to deep midwicket
fuller ball, he drives with the turn to long on
fuller and slanted in from round the stumps, flicked away through midwicket
slower length ball on the pads at 115.7 kph, he waits on it and tucks it to square leg
Sree tries another hopeful full toss, but Hussey gets behind it and drives to extra cover

Raina is gone, one hit too many, Sree lets rip  a full toss that gets on to Raina quicker than he imagined, he again targeted long on, but got only elevation on the ball, RP had settled under the ball at mid on and takes it cleanly
Raina goes for it again, and this one is even bigger, another length ball, he had set himself up, arched back, and deposited him in to the second tier over long on
Raina is taking a liking to Sree, length ball, he bends the knee, gets underneath it and smashes it over mid on, one bounce, in to the boundary
short of a length and Raina takes off, stands in the crease and gets it off the high part of the bat with the big swing, but it carries all the way over long on
tossed up around middle and turning away, runs it with an open face to short third man, excellent control from Murali in the first over
makes some room outside leg, he bowls it very full close to off stump, he reaches out to drive it past Murali to long off
pushes this one away towards extra cover
still fuller, flatter, quicker, watchful forward defence from Raina
bowls this much fuller so he comes forward to smother the turn
back of a length and turning away, pushed down the track off the back foot
goes from the crease to a length ball going across and almost plays it on, inside edge beats the stumps but cannot beat fine leg
short of a length this time and he pushes it away to mid off
angled across the left-hander, and he slashes hard to third man
good delivery, gets a very thick edge this time as it runs past backward point

dropped Parthiv puts it down, Raina just pushed at a shortish ball from the crease, thick edge flew between Parthiv and Owais at wide slip, Parthiv moved to his left, got both gloves to the ball but it popped out, and went towards Owais who could not hold on as well
wide outside off and guided past backward point, third man runs across to field
got 'em, superb delivery, reminds you of England 2007, stinging yorker from wide of the crease, coming in with the angle, Vijay is late in jamming down the bat, and loses the off stump
no difference, this time RP disappears to the straight boundary, length ball, in the slot, Vijay clatters it over the bowler's head
here goes Vijay, playing it with the inward movement, swinging in to the pads, he whips it away with contempt, and gets it past short fine leg
guided to backward point off the back foot
flat-batted down the ground, that will go for four, angled across the batsman who tries to pull it but gets it off the outer half of the bat wide of mid off
flicked away off the pads through square leg
tight stuff, close to off stump on a length, pushed away off the front foot to short extra cover
defends this short of a length ball towards point
width from Sree this time, but now Hussey cannot capitalise, tries to glide it between the tiny gap at point, there are numerous men lurking there, one of them stops it
pushed away towards mid on for a single
runs away to third man as he he dabs a back of a length ball outside off stump
pushed away off the front foot to covers
tip-and-run, neatly done by Hussey, gets behind the line of one rising in to him, plonks it in front of point for an easy single
much straighter this time around off, he taps it in front of Murali at mid off and scampers through for the single
whoops, Vijay misses out again, short and wide, skidding on way outside off, he cracks it straight to point on the bounce
wide enough for the cut, VIjay rocks back and arches for the shot, but hits it without power to point on the bounce
again back of a length and angled across Vijay outside off, pushed away to point
short of a length and moving away outside off stump, he goes for a pull straight away, but mistimes it towards mid on
cuts a short of a length ball wide of sweeper cover and that will be it for Chennai, they are through
bowls it very wide down the leg side, Dhoni goes for it and manages to glove it away, has done some damage to his fingers, Dougie apologises
swats a back of a length ball towards midwicket, Dougie has been superb in this over
targets deep midwicket again but mistimes the slog towards midwicket, Chennai are almost in the play offs now
Owais is run out, Hodge backed away and missed with the big swing, Owais was already half way down the pitch and had no hope of getting back as Dhoni lobbed the ball back to Dougie
very full ball, he goes well deep in the crease and arches back to try and get under it, but can only swing it along the ground to long off, they get back for the second somehow
fires in the yorker outside off stump, dug away towards extra cover
Hodge gets another one away, full toss and he walks across for the pick-up shot over short fine leg, it was a tough chance but he got just one hand to it and it hurried to the boundary
backs away and looks to flat-bat it down the ground but gets it towards extra cover
well bowled, he fires in the yorker, Hodge was deep in the crease eyeing the big swing, can only jab this way past the bowler
clobber! Hodge gets another one, goes flatter this time, stands deep in the crease, length ball and he swats it flat over deep midwicket
smacko! Hodge gets underneath a length ball, backed away towards leg stump, got front leg out of the way, and crashed it over the sightscreen
106.9 slow short of a length ball, tucks it away harmlessly backward of square leg

Suresh Raina takes an excellent catch at deep square leg, Jadeja had walked across and outside off stump to flick the fuller one over short fine leg, edged it high in the air, back went Suresh from backward square leg, kept his eyes on the ball, and took a juggling, diving, tumbling catch in the end, he is delighted with the effort, so he should be
smashed from wide outside the off stump, but couple of bounce to sweeper cover
rides the bounce to steer this one to third man for a single
Jadeja gets another one away, this one will go all the way, very full ball, but Jadeja gets under it, and smacks it hard over mid off, just carries over the ropes
has a wild swing at a short and wide ball outside off stump, gets an under edge on the bounce to Dhoni
short of a length, outside off, Jadeja will get the boundary, gets front foot and cracks it hard, getting on top of the bounce and sending it way past extra cover
no boundary for Kochi, this time it is Dougie on the sweeper cover boundary, it was cut hard off the back foot but to no avail
short and he goes back for the pull, cannot time it well enough
gets it away this time for a single on the off side

the carrom ball, cannot get Ashwin the wicket, Hodge looks to slam it over deep midwicket, but there is no distance on the shot, long on rushes in, deep midwicket rushes in, midwicket rushes back, but the ball beats all three
tucked away off the pads through square leg
skips down the track, gets it goes in the air over a leaping dhoni
can't get it away, goes for the pull off a not-so-short ball, only a single down to long on, the Chennai choke is on here
rocks back to get the cut away this time to sweeper cover
again that bounce from a length, he backs away to cut but has to play it out towards extra cover
shortens the length as he sees him coming down the track, pushed away towards extra cover
gets a lot of bounce this time, he wanted to cut but had to adjust to plonk it down on the off side
fired in with a round-armish action, turns away and it cut towards sweeper cover
hit away towards sweeper cover for a single
Hussey shows the way with a lunging dive to stop a cut at point

dropped swung high in the air, that looked to be going over deep midwicket but went straight to Vijay there, who went at it too casually, almost as if he just needed to get his hands in the way and he would take it, he didn't, it popped out, Vijay looks sheepish, Hussey looks furious
short, does not get up much, maybe that is why he pulls it straight to midwicket
makes room to cut it away to sweeper cover
tries to angle it wide past him as he sees him coming down, but he adjusts to steer it to deep point
goes back to a short of a length ball to work it away to deep midwicket

gone! this was coming, came down in  another of those blind charges, missed the flat ball completely but the ball did not return the favour, it clattered right in to the middle of middle stump, extremely uncharacteristic knock from Baz is over
slower through the air, he pushes it away on the off side
fuller delivery swept away right to the man at deep square leg
sees him walk down the track, shortens the length a long way, and he gets an inside edge on the leg side that Dhoni goes after
flatter one, swept away wide of short fine leg
pushed away in to the off side but cannot beat extra cover
pulled hard off the back foot, that is headed to the boundary but Hussey pulls off another brilliant save with a full-length desperate dive
inside edge saves him, he rushed down the track, and Dhoni would have had an easy stumping to effect but he got an inside edge that took the ball past the keeper
goes for the big sweep, is struck on the back leg, that pitched outside leg though
swung away hard but there is a man at deep midwicket
diving stop by the bowler brings cheers from the crowd, it was pushed back quickly to him
guides the slower on from the crease and backward of point
clobber! finally Kochi get a boundary, full ball, he gets under it, makes some room and lofts it wide of sweeper cover
driven off the front foot to sweeper cover
he went so hard at this one close to off stump, only if he had connected, only if he had
steered wristily to third man for a single
short delivery banged in outside off stump, he can't get to it, that went above the batsman's head, not called a wide
sets himself up for the reverse sweep no matter what, even if it is down the leg side, misses
goes back to punch a shortish ball to long off
almost chops it on the stumps as he goes for a cut off a flat ball close to off
nudges it in front of midwicket for yet another single
turning in from round the stumps, easily tucked away  backward of square leg
fired wide down the leg side, Dhoni whips the bails off
gets the reverse sweep away towards short third man, Kochi need more, asking rate has gone past nine
darted in on a length and plays it out on the leg side
111.9 kph slower and very fuller one, he drives it along the ground to long off
comes forward and opens the face to guide a length ball to point
helped backward of square leg off the pads for another single
shortish and outside off stump, he goes for an uncertain looking cut and gets beaten
tucks it away off the pads but short fine leg dives and keeps them to a single
gets the boundary off the last ball, it is a bit wide outside off and he goes back to cut in the air past short third man
turn an bounce for Raina, he gets hit on the pad as he looks to work it away on the leg side
darted in wide down the leg side from short of a length
looks to back away and dab it fine on the off side, the ball arrives quicker and he plays it out towards point
punches a wide short ball turning in past the bowler and non-striker to long on
another short ball, this one hurries on, but the pull can't get to the boundary, Hussey runs to his right and saves it with a dive
short and turning in, he rocks back to pull it powerfully wide of deep square leg
slower through the air, same result, cannot get it past point with the forward push, excellent over
can't get it away, this is good bowling, fuller around off stump, he pushes it away to point
pushes hard at a short of a length ball that kicks a bit and goes in the air back to the bowler
gets a bit of an inside edge on the leg side, Dhoni goes after the ball, batsmen go for the single,
pushed back to the bowler this time
goes for the reverse sweep, it arrives slower than he thought, and he mistimes it wide of slip who anticipates it very well to save some runs with the dive
gets forward to nudge it away in front of midwicket off the pads
pushes this one back to the bowler
superb take from Dhoni, it was dug in very short, Baz hopped in the air but could not get to it, Dhoni calmly put the glove up and the ball buried itself somewhere within

Bravo does it with the slower one, bowls the bait very full, Rao goes for the big shot over the bowler's head, gets in to it too early, the ball goes high off the edge and Bravo is waiting underneath as it comes down
balls.dismissal: Y Gnaneswara Rao — caught and bowled

balls.text: Bravo darts another one short and wide down the leg side, he looked to get some bat on it but missed
another back of a length ball, rising high on Rao, who gets a thick edge that goes towards the keeper on the bounce as he pushes with soft hands
rides the bounce on a back of a length ball, drops it in front of point, sets off for the single, then stops, then sets off again, before making it back just in time
starts off with a short ball down the pads, and he swivels to swing it fine on the leg side
on the pads and worked away wide of short fine leg
now he waits for one to turn away before guiding it to point
neatly done, goes back to a short of a length ball and tucks it past Bollinger at midwicket for a couple
comes down the track, and belts it over mid on who watches it go over him
short and wide, poor delivery, he cuts it in front of point off the back foot
short of a length around middle and he punches it away towards mid on
flicks in the carrom ball, very full around leg stump, he plays it out towards mid on
short of a length ball, he goes back and tucks it backward of square leg
can't get it away, pushed away towards mid on who cuts off the single
now this one is flatter and fuller, he decides to sweep but misses
comes down the track, but Ashwin drags the length shortish, and he gets an inside edge on the leg side
bowled slowly through the air, turns in on middle and he tucks it with the turn towards square leg
shuffles and stands outside off stump, meets the angled ball with a straight bat, pushing it in front of cover
here comes Baz again, has a big swing from way down the track, the thick edge rolls away to short third man, a disappointed Baz trudges back in to the crease
goes for a cracking pull shot to a short ball around off stump, steepler of a top edge, square leg trots after it, it falls inside the boundary and trickles over the ropes
gets this one away, already standing a foot outside the crease, he stretches forward, gets to this full delivery and carves it one bounce in to the extra cover boundary
short and wide, banged in, Baz comes whistling down the track but can't get anywhere near it, called a wide
wants to mow this one from middle and leg over the bowler, but gets it off the top edge, the ball just beats mid on as he runs back
goes hard at a short and wide ball, slashes it in the air down to third man
tucks a fuller ball away through midwicket
gets it away towards square leg for a single
fuller ball pushed back to the bowler
pushed off the front foot and gets an inside edge in to the leg side

how soft is that for a soft dismissal? saw a flighted ball, and looked to whip it over mid on, ended up mistiming it completely, and the ball hung around in the air and came weakly over to mid on who gladly accepted the gift, PArthiv's horror game is over
turning in slowly but a bit short and worked away through square leg off the back foot
Doug rushes in and bowls a 140 kph length ball going across Baz who arches back and guides it wide of point for a quick single
sees him charge out and slants the full delivery very wide outside off stump
tucks the back of a length ball and gets the single towards square leg
another short ball in to the batsman's body, he goes for an awkward pull and gets an inside edge fine on the leg side
some of those pull fell in square leg when Chennai were batting, now Parthiv gets the top edge off the surprise bouncer, but there is no one at square leg
short and getting up outside off, he rides the bounce to cut hard pas point, third man runs across to field
short of a length and darts in to the left-hander with the angle, defended off the back foot
tossed up fuller and on leg stump, he gets the leading edge as he looks to work it on the leg side
another one goes straight and he comes forward to push to point
length ball going straight on and he pushes it away to midwicket
turns sharply across from leg stump, he adjusts to pull in front of square leg
gets a thick edge as he comes forward and the ball runs away to short third man
angled in from round the stumps and worked in to the leg side for a single
